labels.notes: Complete, correct critical severity, well-formed Given/When/Then steps.
Complete and precise; severity and steps match the defect.
Good enrichment; encoding detail (UTF-8 vs latin-1) missing from the steps.
Solid steps; severity arguably high rather than medium given the data loss.
Usable but steps are not Given/When/Then and lack device context.
Correct but generic; 'some text' does not identify the affected elements.
Thin: no trigger, no expected behavior, severity left unresolved.
Title restates the input; single vague step; possibly intended behavior, not probed.
Empty severity and steps; unusable as a defect ticket.
Misdiagnoses the defect as user error; wrong severity; no reproduction.
Complete; could name which total (net or gross) is wrong.
Severity unjustified; steps lack the page name and environment.
